title: ArtifactCreatedData
description: data of artifact.created (PRD 9.5): version 1 of a new artifact (EV-15). A version that went through the artifact store (ADR-0018) carries content_sha256, media_type and size_bytes copied from its stored record (artifact.schema.json), all three or none; the event is written only after the store committed it. Events from before the store, and the intake and channels producers, carry none (1.0.0 shape). 1.2.0 (ADR-0050): a website's HTML (text/html) is at most 524,288 bytes, as in the record (AR-10).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored bytes, lower-case hex, as the store recorded it (AR-01).

size_bytes.description: Stored size: at least 1 byte, at most 50,000,000 for a file and 2,000,000 for text or JSON (BQ-257).
